    n, x = map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split())
    a = list(map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split()))
    x -= 1
    total_balls = sum(a)
    balls_in_last_box = a[x]
    balls_distributed = total_balls - balls_in_last_box
    boxes_to_distribute = n - x - 1 + n if x < n - 1 else n - 1
    balls_per_box = balls_distributed // boxes_to_distribute
    remainder = balls_distributed % boxes_to_distribute
    result = [0] * n
    current_box = x + 1 if x < n - 1 else 0
    for i in range(n):
        if i < x:
            result[i] = a[i] - balls_per_box - (1 if current_box <= remainder else 0)
            current_box += 1
            if current_box == n:
                current_box = 0
        elif i > x:
            result[i] = a[i] - balls_per_box - ((current_box <= remainder) and (current_box != x))
            current_box += 1
            if current_box == n:
                break
    result[x] = balls_in_last_box + balls_per_box + (remainder >= n - x - 1)
    print(' '.join(map(str, result)))

main()
